text:
Jessica: Heads up — aiming to publish py/ts SDKs during today's 18:00 UTC change window (in ~2h). Need final pin/backout plan + deprecation note for the sync client.
Ali: Got it. Which packages exactly? py: redwood-inference? redwood-cli? ts: @redwood/inference? Any version bumps?
Sam: py: redwood-inference 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0 (removing sync client), ts: @redwood/inference canary -> 2.0.0. Plan: publish canary, monitor, then cohort rollout.
Maya: Canary cohort size? suggest 5% first, monitor errors + SDK telemetry.
Brian: Tests to watch: integration against server v1.2 and v1.3. Note: one partner still on Node 14 — need to decide node14 support or pin.
Jessica: Decision point: either ship a node14-compatible bundle (tiny polyfill) or deprecate node14 and publish a pinned 1.x for partners. Ops/Sales ok with us contacting partners?
Lin: Sales are okay to contact partners if we need a pin. Prefer not to bloat primary bundle with polyfills.
Ali: Two options: A) publish ts 2.0.0 with engines >=14.17 and create a pinned 1.10.x LTS for partners; B) add small compat layer and keep single line. I vote A for clarity.
Sam: +1 option A. Also propose rollback criteria: >1% SDK error rate in canary OR 2x latency increase in first 30m -> rollback.
Jessica: OK final call: do A. Publish canary 2.0.0 to 10% cohort, create pinned 1.10.5 release + deprecation note for node14. @deploy-bot please schedule canary.
deploy-bot: Publish job queued: ts-canary-2.0.0 -> cohort 10% (job id ci-7789). Logs: https://ci.redwood.local/ci-7789
deploy-bot: Publish job SUCCESS ts-canary-2.0.0 cohort 10% (ci-7789). Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.local/ts/2.0.0/canary :tada:
Maya: Starting smoke tests against staging now — will report back in ~10m.
Maya: Smoke findings: one failing test around auth header when using old init pattern. Error: 
```
Error: missing header "x-redwood-token"
    at init (/srv/workspace/packages/ts/src/index.ts:42:15)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/srv/workspace/packages/ts/test/smoke/auth.test.ts:12:5)
```
Ali: I can reproduce locally. Looks like default opts changed (token now required at init time). Quick patch possible in a shim but that changes public surface. Alternative: rollback cohort to 0% until we fix.
Sam: Given partner risk and node14 users, let's rollback cohort to 0% until we clarify. Jessica?
Jessica: Rollback ok. @deploy-bot rollback cohort ci-7789 -> 0% please.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for job ci-7789 -> cohort 0% (started).
deploy-bot: Rollback COMPLETE for ci-7789. Cohort 0% confirmed.
Brian: I'll open a quick PR to reintroduce back-compat init path and release as 2.0.1-compat. We'll also publish pinned 1.10.5 for partners with deprecation note.
Maya: I'll add the old-init test case to prevent regressions.
Jessica: Thanks — I'll update release notes and ping Partner Success with the plan + timeline.
Ali: :thumbsup: Draft deprecation note + pin instructions at https://docs.redwood.local/sdk/release-notes/2-0-0-draft. Will post final release note before tomorrow's change window.
